 News Flash
 Election Day Info and Where to Vote
 Home - Spotlights
 Posted on November 01, 2026 
 League City's general and special elections will be held Tuesday, November 3, 2026.
 In addition to other races on the ballot, voters will choose candidates for several City Council positions and consider Proposition A, regarding fixed automated license plate reader cameras.
 Learn about the election, candidates, and Proposition A.  
 Download a Galveston County sample ballot and find additional election information at  galvestonvotes.org .
 Election Day Date & Hours
 Tuesday, November 3 | 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.
 Election Day Voting Locations
 Johnnie Arolfo Civic Center , 400 W. Walker St.
 The Crossings ,   255 Egret Bay Blvd. (Hall) 
 League City Annex ,   174 Calder Rd. (Community Rm)
 Public Works Operations Center ,   1701 W. League City Pkwy.
 Hometown Heroes Park ,   1001 E. League City Pkwy.
 Bay Colony West HOA , 6621 Calder Rd., Dickinson
 Magnolia Creek HOA , 4751 W. League City Pkwy.
 CCISD Education Support Center , 2425 E. Main St.
